Once we get back, I want to do a longer stream.
There's so much I want to talk about.

...There was no need for any "special" kind of love.
Precisely because I am her Trainer, I was able to be that "bridge."
They were warm, thoughtful, and overflowing with love for Loves Only You.
Thank you, you too, Trainer-chan♡

Having said that, Loves Only You flashed a smile
far brighter than the starry sky.

I'm dropping by unannounced♪
Because this person doesn't understand a siiiingle thing!

Just you wait, Trainer-kun.
I'm coming to find you right away!

Just you wait, Trainer-chan.
I'm coming to find you right away!

Being able to become her Trainer wasn't just because of my desire
to support her, but also thanks to all of her fans.

You chose me and became my Trainer. You connected me with
so many people, and told me to keep carrying those feelings as I run.

(...Trainer-kun.
Have you... been troubled over that this whole time?)
...Geez, you leave me no choice!

(You still looked troubled, so...
I wanted to talk to you, but)

I want to know what kind of special love matches theirs.
Not just the ordinary things I can do as a Trainer.
Thank you, you too, Trainer-kun♡

Who was the person who delivered love to me?
Who was the one who became our "bridge"?

During summer camp, I set notifications for posts to the community,
and every single one was a message of support.

I'm so happy...!
I can't wait to tell everyone that it was the best summer camp ever.

Am I only doing what anyone could as a Trainer?
...Is my love not enough?

And yet, I don't know the way to do it.
No matter how much I think, or try to take action—
(—Ah, how truly...)

...Even I feel like I'm overthinking it.
Yet the fog in my heart refuses to clear.
You were thinking about all that... all by yourself, this whole time.

(...Trainer-chan.
Have you... been troubled over that this whole time?)

Even though she had to teach me before I realized it myself.
When I offer a relieved smile and say thank you, her eyes moisten as well.

...We didn't really get many chances to stream during camp,
so I wonder how all the fans are doing?

Copying her won't magically give me the answer. It was an impulsive
action, but it seemed like a good way to sort through my thoughts.
...Hey, don't you think so?
...I'm such a lucky girl.

What can I do for Loves Only You?
That question continues to swirl inside my chest.

If we have a "bridge" to deliver love, don't you think
we'll be able to receive even more love at our backs from now on?

Summer camp went by in a flash, didn't it?
I learned so much... It was truly a wonderful time!

(...To want to return their feelings.
Just how precious that sentiment is.)
...There's someone standing right here who is so full of love.
I take a deep breath and prepare to let out my jumbled thoughts.

I speak toward the smartphone about just how captivating an Umamusume Loves Only You is.
About how full of love she truly is.

(They weren't near the lodge.
...If that's the case, then the only place left is...)

It's the final night of summer training camp, after all!
We have to end it with fulfilling, wonderful memories.
(To think she feels there isn't enough love...)

(It doesn't look like Trainer's... actually streaming.
It seems to just be a recording, but...)
...Did she notice?

I watch Loves Only You run off with a smile, then look up at the sky.
As the brilliant sun begins to dip below the horizon, summer training camp comes to a peaceful close.

(It doesn't look like Trainer's... actually streaming.
It seems to just be a recording, but...)

I turn her words over in my mind, quietly absorbing them.
Those kind words, overflowing with warmth.

Suddenly, Loves Only You
bursts into the smartphone camera's frame.

Love me♡ Love you♡
It's Loves Only You! ♡

(...I wonder if she'd tell me if I asked now?
I don't want to force an answer out of her, but... still.)

I press the record button on my smartphone and begin to speak.
I'm not actually live streaming. I'm just pretending.

Loves Only You, who helped me take a crucial step forward as a Trainer.
And our friends, who gave me courage.
...Where could Trainer have gone?
...Where could Trainer have gone?
